description: This file defines a class `ImageRenderer` which customizes image rendering in Markdown content for a specific HTML content type. It handles URL resolution, ensuring that image URLs are correctly processed relative to the project structure and external sources, and implements interfaces for rendering and configuration.

classes.name: ImageRenderer
classes.description: A class responsible for rendering image nodes in Markdown content, with URL resolution logic and implementing multiple rendering and configuration interfaces.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing configuration and parent renderer.

methods.name: getCleanUrl
methods.description: Resolves and sanitizes URLs for images, handling external, data, and internal URLs.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders an image node, adjusting its URL before delegating to the parent renderer.

methods.name: setConfiguration
methods.description: Sets configuration for the renderer, delegating to the parent.

methods.name: getXmlTagName
methods.description: Returns the XML tag name used for image nodes, delegating to the parent.

methods.name: getXmlAttributes
methods.description: Returns XML attributes for image nodes, delegating to the parent.
